Maya: Quick sync 16: can we finalize run-of-show + CTA experiment for Wed webinar? need lock by EOD.
Anya: Yep. Topic chosen: "Practical inference economics" with a customer story focus. Speakers: Sam (bench narrative), Leo (demo). Greenroom 09:20 PT, stage 09:40 PT.
Sam: Bench arc: 3 slides but try a storytelling flip this time: start with a customer symptom, then show cost/latency numbers, end with recommendation. Keep to 5m.
Leo: Demo: two short flows (1) optimized-cost, (2) latency-optimized cold start. Ops will pre-warm 6m and prime KV. If p95 > 400ms fallback to quantized model.
Leo: Rehearsal endpoint (ops): curl https://rehearse.redwood-infer/run?model=rw-demo-2026 -d "{input:'prime'}"
Anya: Proposed concise run: 09:20 greenroom; 09:40 intro 2m; 09:42 customer symptom + bench (Sam) 5m; 09:47 demo (Leo) 12m; 09:59 customer vignette 6m; 10:05 Q&A 12m; 10:17 CTAs + close 3m. Total ~57m.
Ben: CTA experiment: Variant A (trial-first) vs Variant B (recording-first). We'll gate the trial offer to first 150 signups. Add hidden field `cta_variant=A|B` and `interest=trial|bench|enterprise`. Routing: trial -> SDR priority, bench -> Growth follow-up, enterprise -> AE.
Maya: Good. Also add optional checkbox "Request security review" that routes to AE queue.
ops-bot: Rehearsal invite created. Ops checklist: pre-warm 6m, run priming prompts (short summarize, 2-bullet rewrite), enable tracing. Set fallback to `rw-demo-2026-quant` if errors or latency spikes.
Sam: I'll attach slide draft and dataset/prompt footnote tonight. Anya: can you schedule 30m full run tomorrow 08:30 PT?
Anya: Done 15: rehearsal invite for 08:30 PT sent. Speakers must upload slides to drive by 6pm.
Maya: Final asks: Ben drop CTA copy variants here, Leo paste priming prompts, confirm HubSpot hidden fields live. We'll lock once uploads + fields verified.
Ben: Variant A: "Request a hands-on trial tailored to your workload 14: seats limited". Variant B: "Watch the recording + get the benchmark pack". Posting in page builder now.
Leo: Priming prompts: 1) "Summarize product in 15 words" 2) "Extract 3 action items". Ops confirmed hidden fields present.
Maya: Thanks all. If slides + hidden fields are green by 6pm we lock the run. :rocket:
